query: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM email_links l JOIN email_mailbox_settings_work w ON w.link_id=l.id WHERE l.id=$1 AND l.provider='IMAP' AND l.is_sync_active AND l.sync_generation=$2 AND l.grant_generation=$3 AND w.kind='sender_block' AND lower(w.resource_key)=lower($4) AND w.desired) AS "blocked!"
